purpose: Verify that adding the explicit OOF filename branch leaves the ordinary validation training path bit-identical when no explicit manifest is supplied.
method: Two isolated source snapshots were copied from the same working tree; the reference snapshot substituted only the two pre-OOF training files from Git 710c502. Both ran the same five-step CPU ordinary-validation fit on the same salt-0 70 TRAIN and 70 validation shots, with the same compact effective YAML reduced to one MLP, CPU, hidden sizes [32,32], head hidden 16, batch 256, five steps, evaluation each step, no early stopping, jobs4. They shared only the verified cache producer/dependency identity. A target-stripped input row from the first validation shot was predicted through each independently loaded artifact.
limit: This is a focused default-path regression on a small CPU fit, not a claim that CPU and production CUDA fits have identical weights or that an OOF pilot has run.
